trigger CREATE TRIGGER s4_observe_del AFTER DELETE ON public.vouchers REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS old_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION _s4_observe()
trigger CREATE TRIGGER s4_observe_ins AFTER INSERT ON public.ledger_events REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS new_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION _s4_observe()
trigger CREATE TRIGGER s4_observe_ins AFTER INSERT ON public.voucher_entries REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS new_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION _s4_observe()
trigger CREATE TRIGGER s4_observe_ins AFTER INSERT ON public.vouchers REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS new_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION _s4_observe()

trigger CREATE TRIGGER s4_observe_upd AFTER UPDATE ON public.voucher_entries REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS new_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION _s4_observe()
trigger CREATE TRIGGER s4_observe_upd AFTER UPDATE ON public.vouchers REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS new_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION _s4_observe()
